engine.label: Container engine
engine.deniedFix: Add your user to the docker group, then sign in again.
engine.startLinux: Start it with sudo systemctl start docker.
engine.startDesktop: Open Docker Desktop and wait until it says it is running.
engine.startPodman: Start the machine with podman machine start.
engine.checksAgain: This page checks again by itself.
engine.install: Install Docker Desktop, Docker Engine or Podman. OxeQuery uses their command-line tool, so anything that works in your terminal works here.

engineBar.label: Docker engine
engineBar.elsewhere_one: No containers in “{{selected}}”, but “{{other}}” has {{count}}. Choose it below.
engineBar.elsewhere_other: No containers in “{{selected}}”, but “{{other}}” has {{count}}. Choose it below.
engineBar.refused: “{{label}}” is a Docker engine on this computer, but your user is not allowed to use it ({{endpoint}}). Add your user to the docker group and sign in again, or choose another engine.

actions.databaseWarning: This is a database container; open connections and running queries are interrupted.
actions.managedVolume: It was created by OxeQuery; its data is kept in a named volume.

stats.label: Usage
stats.notRunning: Start the container to see what it uses.

remove.title: Remove the container {{name}}?
remove.volumes_one: The data in the volume {{volumes}} stays.
remove.volumes_other: The data in the volumes {{volumes}} stays.
remove.noVolumes: It has no named volume; files written inside it are lost.

environment.empty: This container sets no environment variables.
environment.name: Variable
environment.hiddenTitle: Hidden because it is, or may be, a secret
environment.hiddenNote_one: {{count}} value is hidden because it is, or may be, a secret. It never leaves the main process, and agents never see it.
environment.hiddenNote_other: {{count}} values are hidden because they are, or may be, secrets. They never leave the main process, and agents never see them.

bridge.title: Database detected
bridge.unpublished: Its database port is not published, so nothing outside the engine can reach it. Recreate it with a published port (for example -p 5432:5432).
bridge.startFirst: Start the container to connect to it.
bridge.password: OxeQuery asks for the password and keeps it in the vault; agents never see it.

run.explain: Runs once inside {{name}} without a shell, so pipes and quotes are not interpreted. Use the Shell tab for interactive work.
run.startFirst: Start the container to run commands.

shell.startFirst: Start the container to open a shell.

compose.downDescription: Its containers and networks are removed. Named volumes are kept.
compose.label: Compose project {{project}}

resources.label: Images, volumes and networks

removeWarning.image: Containers can no longer be created from it until it is pulled again.
removeWarning.volume: The data in this volume is deleted and cannot be recovered.
removeWarning.network: Containers attached to this network are not affected, but it is removed.

resources.inUse: The engine refuses when it is still in use.

description.containers: Containers that are not running are removed with what they wrote inside them. Named volumes stay. This cannot be undone.
description.images: Image layers no tag or container uses are removed. Tagged images stay. This cannot be undone.

view.emptyText: Containers you start with Docker or Podman show up here, grouped by their Compose project.
view.remoteContext: Docker context {{where}} is active. Everything here — including stop, remove and run command — acts on that host, not on this computer.
